fullText.simplified:
打董卓

    曹操十九岁时出来工作。元少介绍了很多重要的朋友给他，这些朋友后来都帮过曹操的忙。
    再后来，曹操三十五岁了。他为了国家，去杀一个叫董卓的坏人，但是被发现了。董卓要杀他，他跑回家，给很多人写信，请大家来帮他杀董卓。
    董卓是一个非常厉害的人，虽然大家都知道他不是好人，但是他有很多厉害的军队，大家都很怕他。曹操没有助手，钱很少，军队也不多，他要杀董卓，这太难了。
    曹操很着急，不知道谁会来帮忙。他等了两天，等到了第一个来帮他的人——元少！
    元少带着军队来了，他告诉曹操不要着急，他还给一些厉害的人写信，让他们也来帮忙。大家很相信元少，他的话大家都爱听。很快，很多人都带着军队来了。大家一起打败了坏人董卓。
    打完董卓，曹操谢谢元少。元少问曹操：“如果我们没有打败董卓，你会怎么做呢？”
    曹操不知道，他问元少：“你呢？你会怎么做？”
    元少说：“我有厉害的军队，可以往北方去，得到更多地方后，再往南方来，等南方和北方都是我的了，我就谁也不怕了。”
    曹操想了想，说：“我没有厉害的军队，但是我会想办法让聪明的人来为我工作，有了他们，我也可以得到我想要的东西。”
    元少大笑，说：“虽然我们的办法不一样，但想要的东西是一样的，真是不错的朋友！”
    那时候，曹操和元少还是可以相信的朋友。
fullText.traditional:
打董卓

    曹操十九歲時出來工作。元少介紹了很多重要的朋友給他，這些朋友後來都幫過曹操的忙。
    再後來，曹操三十五歲了。他為了國家，去殺一個叫董卓的壞人，但是被發現了。董卓要殺他，他跑回家，給很多人寫信，請大家來幫他殺董卓。
    董卓是一個非常厲害的人，雖然大家都知道他不是好人，但是他有很多厲害的軍隊，大家都很怕他。曹操沒有助手，錢很少，軍隊也不多，他要殺董卓，這太難了。
    曹操很著急，不知道誰會來幫忙。他等了兩天，等到了第一個來幫他的人——元少！
    元少帶著軍隊來了，他告訴曹操不要著急，他還給一些厲害的人寫信，讓他們也來幫忙。大家很相信元少，他的話大家都愛聽。很快，很多人都帶著軍隊來了。大家一起打敗了壞人董卓。
    打完董卓，曹操謝謝元少。元少問曹操：“如果我們沒有打敗董卓，你會怎麼做呢？”
    曹操不知道，他問元少：“你呢？你會怎麼做？”
    元少說：“我有厲害的軍隊，可以往北方去，得到更多地方後，再往南方來，等南方和北方都是我的了，我就誰也不怕了。”
    曹操想了想，說：“我沒有厲害的軍隊，但是我會想辦法讓聰明的人來為我工作，有了他們，我也可以得到我想要的東西。”
    元少大笑，說：“雖然我們的辦法不一樣，但想要的東西是一樣的，真是不錯的朋友！”
    那時候，曹操和元少還是可以相信的朋友。

sentences.traditional: 曹操十九歲時出來工作。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo shí jiǔ suì shí chū lái gōng zuò
sentences.english: Cao Cao went out to work when he was 19 years old.

sentences.simplified: 元少介绍了很多重要的朋友给他，这些朋友后来都帮过曹操的忙。
sentences.traditional: 元少介紹了很多重要的朋友給他，這些朋友後來都幫過曹操的忙。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào jiè shào le hěn duō zhòng yào de péng you gěi tā zhè xiē péng you hòu lái dōu bāng guò cáo cāo de máng
sentences.english: Yuan Shao introduced many important friends to him, and these friends later helped Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 再后来，曹操三十五岁了。
sentences.traditional: 再後來，曹操三十五歲了。
sentences.pinyin: zài hòu lái cáo cāo sān shí wǔ suì le
sentences.english: Later, Cao Cao was 35 years old.

sentences.simplified: 他为了国家，去杀一个叫董卓的坏人，但是被发现了。
sentences.traditional: 他為了國家，去殺一個叫董卓的壞人，但是被發現了。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèi le guó jiā qù shā yí ge jiào dǒng zhuó de huài rén dàn shì bèi fā xiàn le
sentences.english: For the sake of the country, he went to kill a bad man named Dong Zhuo. But he was discovered.

sentences.simplified: 董卓要杀他，他跑回家，给很多人写信，请大家来帮他杀董卓。
sentences.traditional: 董卓要殺他，他跑回家，給很多人寫信，請大家來幫他殺董卓。
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó yào shā tā tā pǎo huí jiā gěi hěn duō rén xiě xìn qǐng dà jiā lái bāng tā shā dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo wanted to kill him. He ran home and wrote to many people, asking everyone to help him kill Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 董卓是一个非常厉害的人，
sentences.traditional: 董卓是一個非常厲害的人，
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó shì yí ge fēi cháng lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo was a very formidable person.

sentences.simplified: 虽然大家都知道他不是好人，但是他有很多厉害的军队，大家都很怕他。
sentences.traditional: 雖然大家都知道他不是好人，但是他有很多厲害的軍隊，大家都很怕他。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán dà jiā dōu zhī dào tā bú shì hǎo rén dàn shì tā yǒu hěn duō lì hai de jūn duì dà jiā dōu hěn pà tā
sentences.english: Although everyone knew that he was not a good man, he had a lot of formidable troops and everyone was afraid of him.

sentences.simplified: 曹操没有助手，钱很少，军队也不多，他要杀董卓，这太难了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操沒有助手，錢很少，軍隊也不多，他要殺董卓，這太難了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo méi yǒu zhù shǒu qián hěn shǎo jūn duì yě bù duō tā yào shā dǒng zhuó zhè tài nán le
sentences.english: Cao Cao had no assistants, little money, and not many troops. It was too difficult for him to kill Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 曹操很着急，不知道谁会来帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 曹操很著急，不知道誰會來幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn zháo jí bù zhī dào shéi huì lái bāng máng
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very anxious and didn’t know who would come to help.

sentences.simplified: 他等了两天，等到了第一个来帮他的人——元少！
sentences.traditional: 他等了兩天，等到了第一個來幫他的人——元少！
sentences.pinyin: tā děng le liǎng tiān děng dào le dì yī ge lái bāng tā de rén yuán shào
sentences.english: He waited for two days until the first person came to help him—Yuan Shao!

sentences.simplified: 元少带着军队来了，他告诉曹操不要着急，
sentences.traditional: 元少帶著軍隊來了，他告訴曹操不要著急，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào dài zhe jūn duì lái le tā gào su cáo cāo bú yào zháo jí
sentences.english: Yuan Shao brought troops with him. He told Cao Cao not to worry.

sentences.simplified: 他还给一些厉害的人写信，让他们也来帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 他還給一些厲害的人寫信，讓他們也來幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái gěi yì xiē lì hai de rén xiě xìn ràng tā men yě lái bāng máng
sentences.english: He also wrote letters to some formidable people and asked them to help.

sentences.simplified: 大家很相信元少，他的话大家都爱听。
sentences.traditional: 大家很相信元少，他的話大家都愛聽。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā hěn xiāng xìn yuán shào tā de huà dà jiā dōu ài tīng
sentences.english: Everyone believed in Yuan Shao, and everyone loved to do what he said.

sentences.simplified: 很快，很多人都带着军队来了。大家一起打败了坏人董卓。
sentences.traditional: 很快，很多人都帶著軍隊來了。大家一起打敗了壞人董卓。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài hěn duō rén dōu dài zhe jūn duì lái le dà jiā yì qǐ dǎ bài le huài rén dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Soon, many people came with troops. Together, they defeated the bad guy Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 打完董卓，曹操谢谢元少。
sentences.traditional: 打完董卓，曹操謝謝元少。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán dǒng zhuó cáo cāo xiè xie yuán shào
sentences.english: After they finished fighting Dong Zhuo, Cao Cao thanked Yuan Shao.

sentences.simplified: 元少问曹操：“如果我们没有打败董卓，你会怎么做呢？”
sentences.traditional: 元少問曹操：“如果我們沒有打敗董卓，你會怎麼做呢？”
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào wèn cáo cāo rú guǒ wǒ men méi yǒu dǎ bài dǒng zhuó nǐ huì zěn me zuò ne
sentences.english: Yuan Shao asked Cao Cao, “If we hadn’t defeated Dong Zhuo, what would you have done?”

sentences.simplified: 曹操不知道，他问元少：“你呢？你会怎么做？”
sentences.traditional: 曹操不知道，他問元少：“你呢？你會怎麼做？”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo bù zhī dào tā wèn yuán shào nǐ ne nǐ huì zěn me zuò
sentences.english: Cao Cao didn’t know. He asked Yuan Shao, “What about you? What would you have done?”

sentences.simplified: 元少说：“我有厉害的军队，可以往北方去，得到更多地方后，再往南方来，
sentences.traditional: 元少說：“我有厲害的軍隊，可以往北方去，得到更多地方後，再往南方來，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào shuō wǒ yǒu lì hai de jūn duì kě yǐ wǎng běi fāng qù dé dào gèng duō dì fang hòu zài wǎng nán fāng lái
sentences.english: Yuan Shao said, “I have formidable troops. I can go to the north. After I get more territory, I can go to the south.

sentences.simplified: 等南方和北方都是我的了，我就谁也不怕了。”
sentences.traditional: 等南方和北方都是我的了，我就誰也不怕了。”
sentences.pinyin: děng nán fāng hé běi fāng dōu shì wǒ de le wǒ jiù shéi yě bú pà le
sentences.english: When the south and the north are both mine, I won’t be afraid of anyone.”

sentences.simplified: 曹操想了想，说：“我没有厉害的军队，
sentences.traditional: 曹操想了想，說：“我沒有厲害的軍隊，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo xiǎng le xiǎng shuō wǒ méi yǒu lì hai de jūn duì
sentences.english: Cao Cao thought for a while and said, “I don’t have formidable troops.

sentences.simplified: 但是我会想办法让聪明的人来为我工作，有了他们，我也可以得到我想要的东西。”
sentences.traditional: 但是我會想辦法讓聰明的人來為我工作，有了他們，我也可以得到我想要的東西。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì wǒ huì xiǎng bàn fǎ ràng cōng ming de rén lái wèi wǒ gōng zuò yǒu le tā men wǒ yě kě yǐ dé dào wǒ xiǎng yào de dōng xi
sentences.english: But I will find a way to get smart people to work for me. With them, I can also get what I want.”

sentences.simplified: 元少大笑，说：“虽然我们的办法不一样，但想要的东西是一样的，真是不错的朋友！”
sentences.traditional: 元少大笑，說：“雖然我們的辦法不一樣，但想要的東西是一樣的，真是不錯的朋友！”
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào dà xiào shuō suī rán wǒ men de bàn fǎ bù yí yàng dàn xiǎng yào de dōng xi shì yí yàng de zhēn shi bú cuò de péng you
sentences.english: Yuan Shao laughed and said, “Although our methods are different, we still want the same things. What a good friend!”

sentences.simplified: 那时候，曹操和元少还是可以相信的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 那時候，曹操和元少還是可以相信的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou cáo cāo hé yuán shào hái shi kě yǐ xiāng xìn de péng you
sentences.english: At that time, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao were still friends and could trust each other.

sentence_translations: Fighting Dong Zhuo
Cao Cao went out to work when he was 19 years old.
Yuan Shao introduced many important friends to him, and these friends later helped Cao Cao.
Later, Cao Cao was 35 years old.
For the sake of the country, he went to kill a bad man named Dong Zhuo. But he was discovered.
Dong Zhuo wanted to kill him. He ran home and wrote to many people, asking everyone to help him kill Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo was a very formidable person.
Although everyone knew that he was not a good man, he had a lot of formidable troops and everyone was afraid of him.
Cao Cao had no assistants, little money, and not many troops. It was too difficult for him to kill Dong Zhuo.
Cao Cao was very anxious and didn’t know who would come to help.
He waited for two days until the first person came to help him—Yuan Shao!
Yuan Shao brought troops with him. He told Cao Cao not to worry.
He also wrote letters to some formidable people and asked them to help.
Everyone believed in Yuan Shao, and everyone loved to do what he said.
Soon, many people came with troops. Together, they defeated the bad guy Dong Zhuo.
After they finished fighting Dong Zhuo, Cao Cao thanked Yuan Shao.
Yuan Shao asked Cao Cao, “If we hadn’t defeated Dong Zhuo, what would you have done?”
Cao Cao didn’t know. He asked Yuan Shao, “What about you? What would you have done?”
Yuan Shao said, “I have formidable troops. I can go to the north. After I get more territory, I can go to the south.
When the south and the north are both mine, I won’t be afraid of anyone.”
Cao Cao thought for a while and said, “I don’t have formidable troops.
But I will find a way to get smart people to work for me. With them, I can also get what I want.”
Yuan Shao laughed and said, “Although our methods are different, we still want the same things. What a good friend!”
At that time, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao were still friends and could trust each other.
